## History

Nora is mentioned as one of Anne's pupils in a detailed letter written to [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md). During a classroom incident, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) asks Nora why she is crying, to which Nora reveals that her brother Tommy had eaten her lunch.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_
